item.title: Canadian Armed Forces member charged in foreign interference investigation
item.description: OTTAWA — A member of the Canadian Armed Forces has been arrested and charged in a joint police operation looking into foreign interference and security of information.

item.title: Another Conservative MP crosses the floor to join Liberal caucus
item.description: OTTAWA — Toronto-area MP Michael Ma left the Conservatives to join the Liberal caucus on Thursday, leaving Prime Minister Mark Carney just one seat shy of a coveted majority government.

item.title: House of Commons rises for six-week holiday break
item.description: OTTAWA — The House of Commons has started its winter break — without the government's lengthy budget implementation bill becoming law.

item.title: P.E.I. Premier Rob Lantz resigning to seek permanent leadership of PC party
item.description: CHARLOTTETOWN — Rob Lantz has announced that he is resigning as premier of Prince Edward Island as he seeks to become the permanent leader of the province's Progressive Conservatives.

item.title: Familiar fate for Abbotsford as floodwaters gush over U.S. border into B.C. again
item.description: ABBOTSFORD — Standing near a rail line next to the U.S. border, Abbotsford, B.C., resident Robbie Friesen said the ground under his feet was dry about 30 minutes earlier.

item.title: Thailand's Parliament is dissolved for new elections early next year
item.description: BANGKOK (AP) — Thailand’s Parliament was dissolved Friday for new elections early next year in a country engaged in deadly fighting with Cambodia.

item.title: Three U.K. men accused of killing Ontario restaurant owner return to Canada
item.description: OWEN SOUND — Police say three men accused in the 2023 death of an Ontario restaurant owner have returned to Canada to face charges.

item.title: Japan lifts tsunami advisory after 6.7 magnitude quake in country's northeast
item.description: TOKYO (AP) — Japan on Friday lifted a tsunami advisory after a 6.7 magnitude earthquake shook the country’s northeast, according to the Japan Meteorological Agency.
